meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把智能体切换到本地模型，减少接口调用成本。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想用本地模型运行 AI 助手，省下 API 调用费。
copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to a local model and save API costs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to run your AI assistant locally and cut API costs.

howto.what: 把指定的 NanoClaw agent group 从 Anthropic API 切到本机 Ollama 模型:改写该组的 container.json 环境变量、在共享 settings.json 里设 model,重建重启后它的请求直接发往本地 Ollama。
howto.when: 当你想让 agent 在本地运行、降低 API 费用或试用开源权重模型时触发;前提是本机 Ollama 已安装并运行,且该 agent group 已存在。

say.note: 会先问你组名、模型名和是否封禁 Anthropic API

say.text: 列一下本机 Ollama 已有的模型,挑一个配上
say.note: 读取本地 Ollama 的模型列表

say.text: 把这个 agent group 切回 Anthropic API

howto.what_en: Points a chosen NanoClaw agent group at a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API: it sets env vars in that group's container.json, sets the model in the shared settings.json, then rebuilds and restarts.
howto.when_en: Use when you want the agent to run locally, cut API costs, or try open-weight models, with Ollama installed and running and the agent group already existing.

say_en.text: Switch this agent group over to a local Ollama model
say_en.note: It asks for group, model, and whether to block Anthropic API

say_en.text: List the Ollama models on this host and pick one for the group
say_en.note: Reads model tags from the local Ollama API

say_en.text: Switch this agent group back to the Anthropic API
say_en.note: Removes env, blockedHosts and model, then restarts
